levelList.name: Move-in Reg.
levelList.desc:
Gain Coin Power based on the following conditions (max 3):
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 [Combustion] Potency on the main target
- Gain Coin Power equal to ([Charge] Potency on self - 1)
[BeforeAttack] This Skill inflicts +([Charge] Potency on self - 1) more [Combustion] Potency (max 2)
[BeforeAttack] Gain +(highest Reson. + 1) [Charge] Count (max 7)

coindescs.desc: [OnSucceedAttack] If target has [IDMicroChip] or [Binding],  inflict +2 [Combustion] Count
